items.statement: Within the stated DFT thermodynamic model, Ga surface alloying at Cu(111) can be thermodynamically relevant near methanol-synthesis conditions even though bulk Cu-Ga alloying is associated with more reducing/high-temperature conditions.
items.expected: Within the stated DFT thermodynamic model, Ga surface alloying at Cu(111) can be thermodynamically relevant near methanol-synthesis conditions even though bulk Cu-Ga alloying is associated with more reducing/high-temperature conditions.

items.statement: The result is a finite-slab, selected-configuration thermodynamic comparison referenced to β-Ga2O3 and should not be read as proof of a unique surface arrangement or kinetic pathway.
